parameters.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'pending' THEN 1 END)::int as pending,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'approved' AND post_status NOT IN ('published','skipped') THEN 1 END)::int as approved,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN post_status = 'published' THEN 1 END)::int as published,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'rejected' THEN 1 END)::int as rejected,
  COUNT(*)::int as total,
  (SELECT daily_post_limit FROM clients WHERE id = 'hr-pro-001') as daily_post_limit
FROM posts;

SELECT
  p.id,
  p.client_id,
  p.content,
  p.topic_pillar,
  p.post_format,
  p.approval_status,
  p.post_status,
  p.approval_note,
  p.scheduled_for,
  array_length(regexp_split_to_array(trim(p.content), '\s+'), 1) as estimated_words,
  p.created_at,
  p.approved_at,
  p.published_at,
  c.name as client_name
FROM posts p
JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id
WHERE
  CASE
    WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'pending' THEN
      p.approval_status = 'pending'
    WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'approved' OR '{{ $json.status }}' = 'scheduled' THEN
      p.approval_status = 'approved'
      AND p.post_status IN ('draft', 'publishing')
      AND p.scheduled_for IS NOT NULL
    WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'history' THEN
      p.post_status = 'published'
      OR p.post_status = 'skipped'
      OR p.approval_status = 'rejected'
    WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'published' THEN
      p.post_status = 'published'
    ELSE
      p.approval_status = 'pending'
  END
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' IN ('approved', 'scheduled')
    THEN p.scheduled_for
    ELSE p.created_at
  END ASC
LIMIT {{ $json.limit }};
